name: card-3d
title: Card 3D
description: OGL-powered 3D card with rounded corners and mouse-tracking parallax rotation.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-blocks/card-3d-element.ts";
---

<motion-card-3d
  image="/path/to/image.jpg"
  width="3.2"
  height="2"
  depth="0.08"
  radius="0.15"
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

usage.label: React
Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-blocks/card-3d-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-card-3d
  image="/path/to/image.jpg"
  width={3.2}
  height={2}
  depth={0.08}
  radius={0.15}
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-blocks/card-3d-element.js"></script>

<motion-card-3d
  image="/path/to/image.jpg"
  width="3.2"
  height="2"
  depth="0.08"
  radius="0.15"
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

props.name: image
props.description: URL of the image to display on the 3D card.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the card in 3D space units.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the card in 3D space units.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius for rounded corners (in 3D space units).
